Quality Assurance / Quality Control Analyst (Engineer) Job at Leitung Gate Limited




        
    

        
        Leitung Gate Limited provides integrated strategic risk planning and management services across functions, units and departments for sustainable organisational growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Quality Assurance / Quality Control Analyst (Engineer)  

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Meeting with clients to discuss areas of focus and improvement within the business.
	Conducting site visits to analyze equipment and established processes.
	Interviewing staff and management to determine the efficacy of personal.
	Gathering and processing data to identify process performance areas.
	Designing workflow and process strategies to improve business performance.
	Creating and presenting process reports for client approval.
	Overseeing the implementation of revised company processes and workflows.
	Monitoring the efficacy of updated workflows.
	Staying up to date with the latest business practices and technologies.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Engineering B.Eng) or similar.
	2-3 years of experience in ISO management systems, Internal/lead auditor role, and implementation.
	Knowledge of any management system
	Proven portfolio of completed projects.
	Risk assessment analysis
	Advanced understanding of business functions, workflows, and processes.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Detailed knowledge of workflow and process control software.
	Analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Good interpersonal and interviewing skills.
	Experience with team management
	Must reside in Port-Harcourt


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.     

    

        Click here to Apply

  "title": "Regional Manager (Eastern Region)",
  "description": "Ishiagu Microfinance Bank Limited is a CBN approved company that economically empower micro-entrepreneurs and unbanked people by providing no collateral loans using our app AidaCredit. Loans range from N4,000 to N1,000,000 with a repayment period of 14 days to 12 months. Customers can also take out multiple loans with a total maximum value of N1,000,000.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Regional Manager (Eastern Region)&nbsp;

Job Location: Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-Time

Description


	Are you an experienced leader with a strong background in Sales, Business Development, Operations, or Team Management?
	We are looking for a Regional Manager to drive business growth, lead teams, manage operations, and achieve performance targets across the Region.
	If you have what it takes to drive growth and lead a high-performing regional team, we want to hear from you!


Key Responsibilities


	Lead and manage regional teams for strong performance.
	Drive sales, business growth, and channel development.
	Build and maintain relationships with key partners and stakeholders.
	Coach and develop team members.
	Conduct regular store visits and ensure operational compliance.
	Monitor performance and take corrective actions where necessary.
	Analyze business data and identify areas for improvement.
	Manage business risks and ensure company policies are followed.
	Prepare regular performance reports.
	Work with other departments to achieve business objectives.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in Sales, Business Development, Operations, mobile phone financing/mobile phone sales and supervisory role.
	Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Proven ability to manage teams and achieve targets.
	Must be willing to travel extensively across the Region.


We are looking fomeone who is:


	Results-driven
	A strong team leader
	Strategic and solution-oriented
	Good with data and decision-making
	Strong in stakeholder management
	Adaptable and able to work under pressure


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their detailed CV to: hr@ishiagumfb.ng using &ldquo;Regional Manager&rdquo; as the subject of the email.

Regional Manager (Eastern Region) Job at Ishiagu Microfinance Bank Limited




        
    

        
        Ishiagu Microfinance Bank Limited is a CBN approved company that economically empower micro-entrepreneurs and unbanked people by providing no collateral loans using our app AidaCredit. Loans range from N4,000 to N1,000,000 with a repayment period of 14 days to 12 months. Customers can also take out multiple loans with a total maximum value of N1,000,000.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Regional Manager (Eastern Region) 

Job Location: Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-Time

Description
     

            
    




	Are you an experienced leader with a strong background in Sales, Business Development, Operations, or Team Management?
	We are looking for a Regional Manager to drive business growth, lead teams, manage operations, and achieve performance targets across the Region.
	If you have what it takes to drive growth and lead a high-performing regional team, we want to hear from you!


Key Responsibilities


	Lead and manage regional teams for strong performance.
	Drive sales, business growth, and channel development.
	Build and maintain relationships with key partners and stakeholders.
	Coach and develop team members.
	Conduct regular store visits and ensure operational compliance.
	Monitor performance and take corrective actions where necessary.
	Analyze business data and identify areas for improvement.
	Manage business risks and ensure company policies are followed.
	Prepare regular performance reports.
	Work with other departments to achieve business objectives.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in Sales, Business Development, Operations, mobile phone financing/mobile phone sales and supervisory role.
	Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Proven ability to manage teams and achieve targets.
	Must be willing to travel extensively across the Region.


We are looking fomeone who is:


	Results-driven
	A strong team leader
	Strategic and solution-oriented
	Good with data and decision-making
	Strong in stakeholder management
	Adaptable and able to work under pressure


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their detailed CV to: [email protected] using “Regional Manager” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Business Development Officer Job at Devien Consult Limited




        
    

        
        Devien Consult Limited is a human resources consulting firm that is dedicated to providing innovative and effective HR solutions to businesses of all sizes.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development Officer 

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time, On-site

Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a results-driven Business Development Officer to drive B2B sales, acquire new clients and grow revenue for engine oil and lubricant products.
	The ideal candidate must have strong B2B sales experience, excellent client relationship skills and a proven ability to achieve sales targets.


Job Responsibilities


	Generate and convert new B2B sales opportunities and corporate accounts.
	Identify and develop relationships with distributors, dealers, workshops, fleet operators and other potential clients.
	Promote and sell the company's engine oil and lubricant products.
	Manage existing clients and drive repeat business and customer retention.
	Conduct market research and identify new business opportunities.
	Prepare quotations, negotiate with clients and follow up on sales leads to closure.
	Achieve assigned sales targets and revenue objectives.
	Prepare regular sales reports and provide market and customer feedback to management.


Job Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess an HND / Bachelor's Degree
	Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in B2B Sales/Business Development.
	Experience in engine oil, lubricants, automotive products or related industries is an added advantage.
	Proven ability to generate leads, acquire clients and close sales.
	Strong B2B client relationship and account-management skills.
	Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
	Target-driven, proactive and results-oriented.


Salary
N250,000 - N300,000 monthly.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
